are_you_ok.title: H-E-B recalls jalapeño products over potential salmonella contamination
are_you_ok.summary: H-E-B, the San Antonio-based grocery chain that dominates Texas, said all products currently available in its stores are safe and are not impacted by the recall.
questions: Did the recall affect anything you'd bought?

you_should_know.title: SAPD officers seen fatally shooting armed suspect in newly shared bodycam video
you_should_know.description: The early morning confrontation began with police trying to stop a bicyclist on the sidewalk before he is seen in the footage trying to escape.
